title: Executable work for a small-bias output bit
statement: For natural numbers $\ell$ and $c$, define the work required for output coordinate $c$ to be the executable small-bias power work at parameters $\ell$ and $c+1$, plus the executable binary dot-product work at parameter $\ell$, plus one.
caveat: The snippet uses executable small-bias power work and executable binary dot-product work without defining them, so their meanings cannot be stated more explicitly.
